title: RobustNCL: Robustifying Neuromorphic Continual Learning under Transient Faults with Lightweight Detect-and-Cure Strategy
abstract: arXiv:2610.31954v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In neural networks, continual learning (CL) is a prominent approach for enabling deployed systems to adapt to dynamic operational environments by effectively learning from new unseen data at runtime. Recently, the neuromorphic continual learning (NCL) concept has emerged as an energy-efficient alternative to CL by leveraging sparse event-based operations. However, NCL performance can be undermined by transient faults in the hardware platforms, which may come from high-energy particle strikes at any time. Currently, NCL reliability under transient faults has not been studied, and hence the corresponding fault-tolerance techniques remain unexplored. To address this, we propose a novel RobustNCL framework to improve NCL reliability in the presence of transient faults in the DRAM-based off-chip memory of hardware platforms through a lightweight detect-and-cure strategy. translated_title: RobustNCL：基于轻量级检测与修复策略增强瞬态故障下神经形态持续学习的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 在神经网络中，持续学习（CL）是一种重要的方法，通过在运行时有效地从新的未见数据中学习，使已部署的系统能够适应动态的运行环境。最近，神经形态持续学习（NCL）概念通过利用稀疏的基于事件的运算，成为了一种节能的持续学习替代方案。然而，NCL的性能可能受到硬件平台中瞬态故障的损害，这些故障可能随时由高能粒子撞击引起。目前，NCL在瞬态故障下的可靠性尚未被研究，因此相应的容错技术仍未被探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的RobustNCL框架，通过轻量级的检测与修复策略，提升硬件平台中基于DRAM的片外存储器存在瞬态故障时NCL的可靠性。具体而言，该框架首先监测权重更新过程中出现的故障……
tldr: 本文提出RobustNCL框架，通过轻量级检测与修复策略提升神经形态持续学习在硬件瞬态故障（特别是DRAM片外存储器故障）下的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RobustNCL, a novel framework that improves the reliability of neuromorphic continual learning under transient faults in DRAM-based off-chip memory through a lightweight detect-and-cure strategy.
